display_long_description:
Shape the Future of the Game! 🛠️
We are in Early Access, and your feedback is everything to us. Join our Discord to chat directly with the developer, suggest new features, report bugs, and vote on what we should build next!

👉 https://discord.com/invite/W6j23xmvdx


### Explore a Huge, Relaxing World
Step into a massive 2-square-kilometer world built for pure relaxation. You have total freedom to explore at your own pace, whether you are cruising in your boat or fishing from a quiet shore. With 5 unique regions and 12 different habitats to unlock, a perfect fishing spot is always waiting for you.

---

### Discover New Fish and Secrets
[media]

Every cast is a new adventure. Track down and catch 36 unique types of fish hidden throughout the world. 

* First-Time Catches: Catch a new fish to add it to your Collection and earn extra XP to level up!
* Hidden Treasures: Keep your eyes open while you explore—there are hidden chests full of rewards to find.

---

### Upgrade Your Gear
[media]

Trade your catches at the shop for great upgrades to prepare for bigger trips:

* Better Rods – Helps you reel much faster.
* New Boats – Travel across the massive map much faster.
* Bigger Buckets – Hold more fish so you can stay out longer.



As you play, unlock fun in-game achievements and see your name rise on the Global Leaderboard to become the ultimate master angler!
